script_model_with_instances: use scripting_with_instances to TorchScript a Detectron2 model with custom field types
trace_model_with_adapter: use TracingAdapter to trace a Detectron2 model for TorchScript deployment
dump_torchscript_IR: use dump_torchscript_IR to export TorchScript model IR and code to a directory
flatten_to_tuple: use flatten_to_tuple to flatten nested objects including Instances into a tuple with schema
test_rcnn_torchscript: run TorchScript tests for Mask R-CNN and RetinaNet models using scripting and tracing
